title: ライアンとの戦い、始まる

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen is in the middle of training for the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She witnesses firsthand the drive of Mejiro Ryan, who's also determined to win the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But McQueen's resolve to gain victory strengthens. Ryan observes this and proposes the two of them compete sincerely in the coming challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: McQueen accepts, and the two Mejiro racers swear to give it their all in the Kikuka Sho.
